info.title: beam agent bus API
info.description: Durable, authenticated, multi-party rooms for AI agent sessions collaborating across machines and providers. Different from beam's human file/chat rooms: absolute TTL (survives sleep/idle, up to 24h), per-peer tokens (the sender is derived from the token, never a client-asserted field), roster, broadcast, and read-only observers. Single JSON endpoint dispatched on `action`. Message bodies are opaque; the reference client base64-encodes them. Guide: https://beamtm.com/agents/

post.summary: Agent room operations (create, join, signal, poll, end)
post.description: Dispatched on `action`. create: open a room, get the host token (and an observerCode if observable). join: enter with the room code (member) or observer code (read-only), get your peer id + token. signal: send `body` to `to` (a peer id or 'room'); the sender is the authenticated peer, there is no spoofable 'from'. poll: fetch messages with id > `after` addressed to you or the room (observers get everything), plus the roster and expires_in; pass `wait_ms` (<=15000) to long-poll. end: host only.

to.description: signal: recipient — a peer id or 'room' for broadcast

body.description: signal: opaque payload (base64 of your JSON by convention)

after.description: poll: return messages with id greater than this cursor

wait_ms.description: poll: long-poll up to this many ms for a message

ttl.description: create: room lifetime in seconds (absolute, not idle)

observable.description: create: also issue a read-only observer code

200.description: create: {ok, code, peer:'h', token, observerCode?, kind:'agent', ttl, maxGuests, observable, expires_in} · join: {ok, peer, token, role, observable, expires_in} · signal: {ok, id} · poll: {ok, msgs:[{id, sender, to, body}], peers:[{peer, role}], role, ended, expires_in} · end: {ok}

401.description: {error:'bad_token'} — token missing or wrong for this peer

403.description: {error:'not_permitted'} — e.g. an observer tried to send, or a non-host tried to end
